description: Mark a task or step done, with a summary of what you did and, optionally, a structured outcome: files changed (with +/- line counts), checks run (pass/fail/skip), links (PR, commit, branch, deploy, doc), follow-up task ids, risks and how the person can verify it. The person sees it as a What changed card; a step's outcome rolls up to its task. When the person should look at the work, pass needs_review: true with outcome.verify (how you checked it): the task lands in their Ready for review queue. Completing a step tells you the next one; start_next: true also starts it, and finish_task: true on the last open step closes the task too (with the same summary) in one call. For a step it returns steps done, the task's bar and the next step's id (or, after the last step, a reminder to complete the task). Completing a task closes its open steps. Repeating it on a task that is already done changes nothing and keeps the first summary (add more with taskhold_add_note); an unknown task_id fails with "Task not found", an invalid outcome fails without changing anything.

finish_task.description: When completing the last open step, also complete its task with this summary (default false)

needs_review.description: Ask the person to review the work: the task goes to their Ready for review queue (it still counts as done). Needs outcome.verify, a short "how I checked it" line. They approve it or request changes; both arrive in taskhold_updates (default false)

outcome.description: What changed, shown to the person as a What changed card (20 KB max). Every field is optional.

checks.description: Checks you ran, e.g. [{name: "bun test", result: "pass", detail: "212 tests"}] (max 20)

follow_ups.description: Ids of tasks you filed for leftover work (from taskhold_create)

links.description: PR, commit, branch, deploy or doc links (url may be a sha or branch name) (max 20)

risks.description: What could go wrong or still needs a look (max 5)

verify.description: How the person can check it themselves, e.g. the command or page to open

start_next.description: When completing a step, start the next step too (default false)

summary.description: What was done (and how you checked it). Markdown.

task_id.description: The ID of the task to complete

name: taskhold_complete
title: Complete a task
